classification.difficultyReason: Choose a sine-rule side or cosine-rule angle as the missing prerequisite for area.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these triangles by using either sine rule or cosine rule to find the required information. Give your answer to 2 d.p.

spec.description: Blue triangle pointing right, vertical left edge; 13 cm above the upper edge. Black internal angle arcs and labels 75° at upper left and 80° at lower left. No printed vertex letters.
spec.mathematics: The side 13 cm is opposite 80°; the remaining angle is unlabelled.

answer.worked:
Let $s$ be the side opposite the remaining angle.
$$\begin{align*}
C&=180^\circ-75^\circ-80^\circ=25^\circ\\[8pt]
\frac{s}{\sin25^\circ}&=\frac{13}{\sin80^\circ}\\[8pt]
s&=\frac{13\sin25^\circ}{\sin80^\circ}\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(13)\left(\frac{13\sin25^\circ}{\sin80^\circ}\right)\sin75^\circ\\[8pt]
A&\approx35.03\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Blue triangle with upper-left, lower-left and upper-right vertices. Left edge labelled 8 m; top edge rises slightly to the right. Black internal angle arcs label 62° at lower left and 33° at upper right. No vertex letters.

answer.worked:
Let $s$ be the side opposite $62^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}
C&=180^\circ-62^\circ-33^\circ=85^\circ\\[8pt]
\frac{s}{\sin62^\circ}&=\frac{8}{\sin33^\circ}\\[8pt]
s&=\frac{8\sin62^\circ}{\sin33^\circ}\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(8)\left(\frac{8\sin62^\circ}{\sin33^\circ}\right)\sin85^\circ\\[8pt]
A&\approx51.68\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Blue triangle with lower-left vertex and vertical right edge. Long rising diagonal labelled 66 m outside left, right edge 38 m outside right, lower edge 51 m below. No angle marks or vertex letters.
spec.mathematics: Side lengths 66 m, 38 m and 51 m.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the angle between the $38\text{ m}$ and $51\text{ m}$ sides.
$$\begin{align*}
\cos\theta&=\frac{38^2+51^2-66^2}{2(38)(51)}\\[8pt]
\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{38^2+51^2-66^2}{2(38)(51)}\right)\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(38)(51)\sin\theta\\[8pt]
A&\approx965.88\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Blue triangle with horizontal upper edge labelled 28 m, short edge sloping down-right labelled 16 m outside right, and long diagonal labelled 36 m below. No angle marks or vertex letters.
spec.mathematics: Side lengths 28 m, 16 m and 36 m.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the angle between the $28\text{ m}$ and $16\text{ m}$ sides.
$$\begin{align*}
\cos\theta&=\frac{28^2+16^2-36^2}{2(28)(16)}\\[8pt]
\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{28^2+16^2-36^2}{2(28)(16)}\right)\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(28)(16)\sin\theta\\[8pt]
A&\approx214.66\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Blue triangle with horizontal upper edge labelled 3 km and a bottom-right tip. Black internal arcs label 42° at upper left and 112° at upper right. No vertex letters.
spec.mathematics: 3 km is opposite the unlabelled third angle.

answer.worked:
Let $s$ be the side opposite $112^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}
C&=180^\circ-42^\circ-112^\circ=26^\circ\\[8pt]
\frac{s}{\sin112^\circ}&=\frac{3}{\sin26^\circ}\\[8pt]
s&=\frac{3\sin112^\circ}{\sin26^\circ}\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(3)\left(\frac{3\sin112^\circ}{\sin26^\circ}\right)\sin42^\circ\\[8pt]
A&\approx6.37\text{ km}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Blue triangle with top apex, lower-left and lower-right vertices; base slopes down-right. Left side labelled 1.3 km outside upper-left, right side 1.4 km outside right, base 1.2 km below. No angle marks or vertex letters.
spec.mathematics: Side lengths 1.3 km, 1.4 km and 1.2 km.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the angle between the $1.3\text{ km}$ and $1.4\text{ km}$ sides.
$$\begin{align*}
\cos\theta&=\frac{1.3^2+1.4^2-1.2^2}{2(1.3)(1.4)}\\[8pt]
\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1.3^2+1.4^2-1.2^2}{2(1.3)(1.4)}\right)\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(1.3)(1.4)\sin\theta\\[8pt]
A&\approx0.72\text{ km}^2
\end{align*}$$
